description: Do you have recursive hierarchical data that you can't display in Power BI? Do you need to present a bill of materials or a parts list? Do you want to visualize your employees with their managers in an intuitive way? Do you work with other parent-child hierarchies? If so, the Recursive Hierarchy Chart is perfect for you! This visual enables you to analyse such data by displaying it in an organized view and highlighting the biggest drivers - Directly in Power BI! User can intuitively interact with the data since the visual resembles a standard Power BI decomposition tree and offers many of the same customization options. They can: Highlight the biggest drivers for an item Drag and pan to display the data Collapse and expand items Select an item along with all its children Would you rather display your data in a table? We also offer a second visual: the Recursive Hierarchy Table, which visually resembles a standard matrix visual. The table visualization is better for quickly getting detailed information about your items and analyzing their parents/children. The chart visualization, on the other hand, is better for a graphic overview of all items and analyzing key drivers. The free version offers full support for any hierarchy level but allows only one additional attribute.
